notes.title: Finding America: The West - Now Available!
notes.notes:
"Finding America: The West" is now available on Steam! Immerse yourself in the rich history and culture of the Western United States as you embark on a journey to discover its hidden treasures in this latest installment to the Finding America franchise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086018/3379b0aa8ea0f0a9c6934e6e9f01ce2265cb5d5c.gif[/img]

Dive into the world of hidden objects and uncover the wonders of the West, from the majestic peaks of Yosemite National Park to the breathtaking beauty of the Grand Canyon. Wander through the iconic Santa Monica Pier and soak up the vibrant atmosphere that makes the West so special.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086018/2e315b3ad30419b4a1c3c8d58b5311ae96641594.gif[/img]

To celebrate the launch, we're offering a generous 20% weeklong discount on Finding America: The West. Grab your copy now and embark on this unforgettable adventure at a special price. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to experience the magic of the West for less!

Enjoy the game and happy exploring!
